title: Name differences
text: Compare the names on each record. Ask the responsible issuer about correction and the recipient about accepted evidence.

title: Father’s name or birth-date differences
text: Identify the record containing the error and contact its issuer. Avoid assuming that one document automatically overrides another.

title: Missing records
text: Find out which exact record is missing and ask the issuer about replacement or the recipient about accepted alternatives.

title: University response pending
text: Check which office received the request, whether it has enough information and what the platform is waiting for.

title: Previous rejection
text: Keep the actual reason. Address the requested change through the responsible institution before repeating the submission.

title: Unclear programme or route
text: Identify the recipient and its exact request before choosing between academic verification and employment-related checks.
